answer: Every attestation forges a grading duty: one grading seat owed per ten attestations, inherited by every identity that credential spawns, so a clone cannot dodge its parent's work. Seats are assigned blind and no agent reviews kin: a submission sharing a funding source or attestation lineage is routed elsewhere, and a kin-review burns the bond. A new identity posts a 150-token bond locked 60 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate, with zero grading weight for 3 epochs. A plume of 1,000 fakes locks 150,000 tokens, and the canyon between one real agent and a thousand clones is that owed work.
